description: Single full-body native pixel-art game sprite. IDENTITY MUST MATCH: Stocky FAT middle-aged office man with large round belly, soft thick arms, round full face and double chin, tired narrow brown eyes and worried strained smile. Short dark brown hair side-parted with short uneven fringe, receding temples. Thin rectangular clear glasses. White long-sleeved shirt stretched over belly, dark black tie, black trousers and belt. NO jacket or lab coat. Relaxed upright SOUTH-facing stance, empty hands visible at sides, low top-down camera. Natural adult anatomy and normal torso/pelvis. Anatomical crown-to-sole height 212-224px on128x256, hair/cap excluded from body height. Soles at y248, leave unused space above shorter people, NEVER enlarge to fill canvas. Keep original individual body shape. Match style reference ONLY for crisp native1px clusters, selective dark outlines and controlled shading; own colors and clothes. Transparent background, no shadow, no text, no weapons. Entire hair and shoes inside frame.

style_image.usage_description: Use ONLY pixel rendering, outline, shading and lighting. Do not copy the reference male height, body shape, shoulder width, outfit or identity. Preserve this character own stature, build, age, hair, irises and original clothing colors and silhouette. FRONT view.
